One of the best days I’ve had in a really, really long time… all because of my incredible group of guys. My boys. ❤️

When I moved here from California in 2018, I didn’t know a single person. And somehow, God dropped me right into the middle of the most loving, hilarious, genuine group of humans I could’ve ever asked for. These guys (and gals) have filled my Tennessee years with so much joy, laughter, adventure, and love.

From a steeplechase party at the winery… to Mexican food and margaritas celebrating Billy’s birthday… to somehow eating roadside donuts for dinner… all the way to waking up in the middle of the forest… WOOOWEEE what a frickin’ day. 😂

And I swear there was not one single moment where we weren’t laughing our butts off.

Sometimes I stop and think… who would’ve thought my life would look like this?

Dating my best friend of 7 years… who somehow turned into the man of my dreams and my whole world. Watching my incredible son get ready to take flight into the real world. Parents who are healthy, close by, and still with us. A business that’s finally about to take off with the most incredible team beside me. Friendships that feel like family.

There is just so much to be grateful for right now I honestly can’t even count the blessings anymore.

Life has not always been easy. But man… days like today remind me just how beautiful it can be. ❤️
